description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.05 USDC per call via x402] Match two lists that should agree, line by line, and list everything that does not: bank statement vs ledger, invoices vs payments received, payouts vs orders. Rules, in order: same reference and amount; same reference but a different amount (reported as a mismatch); then same amount within amountTolerance and dates within dateWindowDays. Each line matches at most once. Set sign "opposite" when one side records money out as negative, or "ignore" to compare sizes only. Returns matched pairs (row numbers on both sides), amount mismatches, unmatched lines on each side, and exact totals: left, right, matched, unmatched and the difference. Up to 5000 lines per side. Deterministic, exact decimals.

amountTolerance.description: largest amount difference that still counts as equal, e.g. "0.01"; default 0 (exact)

dateFormat.description: how to read slash dates; ISO dates always work

dateWindowDays.description: largest date gap for a match when both lists have dates; default 3 (bank posting delays)

left.description: the first list, e.g. the bank statement

csv.description: the lines as CSV with a header row (instead of rows)

date.description: the date column (optional; enables the date window)

name.description: what this list is, e.g. "bank" or "ledger"

ref.description: a reference column to match on first: invoice number, order id, transaction id

right.description: the second list, e.g. the ledger

name: reconcile
